remarks: Welcome to the one you've been waiting for! Renovated with impeccable taste in 2023, this stunning two-bedroom residence combines flawless design with modern luxury in one of Stamford's most convenient locations. From the moment you step through the door, you'll be wowed by the open-concept layout, elegant millwork, and stylish finishes throughout. The sleek, modern kitchen features quartz countertops and contemporary flooring - a perfect blend of function and sophistication. Both the primary and guest bedrooms have been thoughtfully designed with comfort and style in mind, making this home ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Enjoy the convenience of one assigned parking space, plus ample street parking right outside the building. The HOA includes heat, hot water, and gas - and best of all, Edgewater is a pet-friendly community. Don't miss your chance to call this beautifully updated space home!
